Fan Chen, Sinho Chewi, Jianfeng Lu and Matthew S. Zhang, arXiv2609.06905v1 Appendix A.1 (A.2), A1.E2 and the between-jump paragraph A1.SS1.p2.2, with nonaccumulation p3.7. The joint measurable physical-time representative and initialization adapter is an ASTIS completion of an implicit construction step, not a quotation or the full Proposition3.1.
Let E be any finite-dimensional real inner-product space, including dimension zero, with its Borel measurable structure. Let V:E→ℝ be C². Let α,β be nonnegative reals and η a real number satisfying α>0, α≤β, α‖v‖²≤D²V(x)[v,v]≤β‖v‖² for every x,v∈E, η>0, and βη≤1. Allow arbitrary parameters y,xRef∈E and initial phase z0=(x0,p0)∈E×E. Set c=y−η∇V(xRef). For z=(x,p), define the actual harmonic flow Φ_t(z)=(c+cos(t)(x−c)+√η sin(t)p, −sin(t)(x−c)/√η+cos(t)p), reflection S(z)=(x,p−[2〈p,g(x)〉/‖g(x)‖²]g(x)), residual g(x)=∇V(x)−∇V(xRef), and rate λ(z)=√η max{0,〈p,g(x)〉}. The reflection uses total real division, hence is the identity when g(x)=0. Define Λ(z,t)=∫_0^t λ(Φ_s(z)) ds for finite t≥0 and τ(z,e)=inf{t≥0:Λ(z,t)≥e}, with inf empty=∞. Let P be the actual countable product of rate-one exponential Borel measures on Ω=ℝ^ℕ; let ε_k(sample)=max{sample_k,0} viewed as a nonnegative real. Define active records (T,z) and an absorbing stopped record carrying no phase. Initialize record0=(0,z0). At index k, a stopped record stays stopped; an active record (T,z) becomes stopped if τ(z,ε_k)=∞ and otherwise becomes (T+τ(z,ε_k), S(Φ_{τ(z,ε_k)}(z))). Its event time T_k is the finite time component if active and ∞ if stopped. There exists a total phase map Z:E×E×(E×E)×[0,∞)×Ω→E×E jointly Borel measurable in all displayed parameters, finite physical time t and sample, while V,α,β,η remain fixed. For every parameter triple, every sample, every finite t and any actual covering index n with T_n≤t<T_(n+1), if record_n=inl(a) with a=(s,z), then Z(y,xRef,z0,t,sample)=Φ_(t−s)(z), where subtraction is the NNReal nonnegative subtraction. If no such actual covering index exists, Z(y,xRef,z0,t,sample)=z0. This uncovered value is an explicitly chosen ASTIS total representative convention, not a source state supplied on exceptional inputs. Furthermore, for each fixed deterministic y,xRef,z0, for P-almost every sample simultaneously: for every finite nonnegative t there exist n and an actual finite live record a=(s,z) with T_n≤t<T_(n+1), record_n=inl(a), s≤t, t−s<τ(z,ε_n) and Z(y,xRef,z0,t,sample)=Φ_(t−s)(z); and Z(y,xRef,z0,0,sample)=z0. A stopped record never provides the source phase. An infinite next wait retains the last live harmonic arc for all later finite t and does not trigger the uncovered fallback. The AE event may depend on the fixed parameter triple; no uniform event over all parameters is asserted. Joint measurability permits later measurable parameter evaluation, but per-parameter AE agreement cannot be substituted at arbitrary parameters correlated with sample without a separate law/independence/conditional-kernel argument. This is an ASTIS source-implicit measurable realization of Appendix A.1's actual between-jump prescription, not the full process/Markov/invariance/main sampler/error/query-cost/composition theorem. No positive dimension, energy, cap, selector, nonexplosion, positive support, measurable flow or higher regularity certificate is a new premise.

The six analytic hypotheses are the only supplied mathematical premises. fderiv is the Frechet derivative, gradient is the real inner-product gradient, and ContDiff real 2 means twice continuously differentiable.

expMeasure 1 is the rate-one exponential measure on the real line. infinitePi is the canonical countable product on all real sequences. toNNReal is max(x,0) viewed as a nonnegative real, including exceptional nonpositive coordinates.

hittingAfter f s 0 a denotes the infimum of nonnegative times at which f(t)(a) belongs to s, with infinity for an empty hit set. WithTop NNReal includes a greatest element top. untopD 0 returns the finite value when finite, and zero at top; the guard branches before evaluating a finite-state update.

Sum.inl stores a finite accumulated time and state pair. Sum.inr Unit is the absorbing stopped record, represented by eventTime top and carrying no state at infinity. Nat.rec initializes at (0,z0) and uses coordinate k in update k to k+1.

Products associate to the right. Measurable means Borel measurable for the displayed finite-dimensional, nonnegative-time and countable product measurable structures. NNReal subtraction is max(t-s,0). A quantified function witness is a total map; no measurable selection or trajectory is supplied as an assumption.

    [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E]
    {V : E → ℝ} {α β : ℝ≥0} {η : ℝ}
    (hα : 0 < (α : ℝ)) (hαβ : α ≤ β) (hV : ContDiff ℝ 2 V)
    (hH : ∀ x v : E,

      (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ V) x v) v ≤ (β : ℝ) * ‖v‖ ^ 2)
    (hη : 0 < η) (hβη : (β : ℝ) * η ≤ 1) :
    actual_physical_time_measurable_phase_statement hα hαβ hV hH hη hβη := by
  classical
  let P : Measure (ℕ → ℝ) := Measure.infinitePi (fun _ : ℕ => expMeasure (1 : ℝ))
  let ε : (ℕ → ℝ) → ℕ → ℝ≥0 := fun sample k => Real.toNNReal (sample k)
  let c : E → E → E := fun y xRef => y - η • gradient V xRef
  let Φ : E → E → ℝ → (E × E) → (E × E) := fun y xRef t z =>
    (c y xRef + Real.cos t • (z.1 - c y xRef) +
        (Real.sqrt η * Real.sin t) • z.2,
     (-Real.sin t / Real.sqrt η) • (z.1 - c y xRef) + Real.cos t • z.2)
  let S : E → (E × E) → (E × E) := fun xRef z =>
    (z.1, z.2 - (2 * inner ℝ z.2 (gradient V z.1 - gradient V xRef) /
      ‖gradient V z.1 - gradient V xRef‖ ^ 2) • (gradient V z.1 - gradient V xRef))
  let rate : E → (E × E) → ℝ := fun xRef z =>
    Real.sqrt η * max 0 (inner ℝ z.2 (gradient V z.1 - gradient V xRef))
  let Λ : E → E → (E × E) → ℝ≥0 → ℝ := fun y xRef z t =>
    ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..(t : ℝ), rate xRef (Φ y xRef s z)
  let τ : E → E → (E × E) → ℝ≥0 → WithTop ℝ≥0 := fun y xRef z e =>
    MeasureTheory.hittingAfter
      (fun t : ℝ≥0 => fun a : (E × E) × (E × E) × ℝ≥0 =>
        Λ a.1.1 a.1.2 a.2.1 t - (a.2.2 : ℝ))
      (Set.Ici (0 : ℝ)) 0 ((y, xRef), z, e)
  let next : E → E → ℝ≥0 → ((ℝ≥0 × (E × E)) ⊕ Unit) →
      ((ℝ≥0 × (E × E)) ⊕ Unit) := fun y xRef e r =>
    match r with
    | Sum.inr _ => Sum.inr ()
    | Sum.inl a =>
      if τ y xRef a.2 e = ⊤ then Sum.inr () else
        Sum.inl (a.1 + (τ y xRef a.2 e).untopD 0,
          S xRef (Φ y xRef (((τ y xRef a.2 e).untopD 0 : ℝ≥0) : ℝ) a.2))
  let record : E → E → (E × E) → (ℕ → ℝ≥0) → ℕ →
      ((ℝ≥0 × (E × E)) ⊕ Unit) := fun y xRef z₀ e n =>
    Nat.rec (Sum.inl (0, z₀)) (fun k r => next y xRef (e k) r) n
  let eventTime : E → E → (E × E) → (ℕ → ℝ≥0) → ℕ → WithTop ℝ≥0 :=
    fun y xRef z₀ e n => (record y xRef z₀ e n).elim
      (fun a => (a.1 : WithTop ℝ≥0)) (fun _ => ⊤)
  have h76 := ActualFiniteJumpRecursion.actual_fixed_reference_finite_jump_recursion
    hα hαβ hV hH hη hβη
  rcases h76 with ⟨hinit, _, _, hrecordM, htimeM, hmono, _, _, _, hstrict⟩
  have hflow := ActualHarmonicFlow.actual_harmonic_flow_laws hα hαβ hV hH hη hβη
  have hΦM : Measurable (fun a : (E × E) × ℝ × (E × E) =>
      Φ a.1.1 a.1.2 a.2.1 a.2.2) := hflow.2.1
  have hΦ0 : ∀ y xRef : E, ∀ z : E × E, Φ y xRef 0 z = z := hflow.2.2.1
  have hεM : Measurable ε := measurable_pi_lambda _ fun n =>
    measurable_real_toNNReal.comp (measurable_pi_apply n)
  let A := ((E × E) × (E × E)) × ℝ≥0 × (ℕ → ℝ)
  let args : A → (E × E) × (E × E) × (ℕ → ℝ≥0) :=
    fun a => (a.1.1, a.1.2, ε a.2.2)
  have hargs : Measurable args := measurable_fst.fst.prodMk
    (measurable_fst.snd.prodMk (hεM.comp measurable_snd.snd))
  have hrM (n : ℕ) : Measurable (fun a : A =>
      record a.1.1.1 a.1.1.2 a.1.2 (ε a.2.2) n) := (hrecordM n).comp hargs
  have hTM (n : ℕ) : Measurable (fun a : A =>
      eventTime a.1.1.1 a.1.1.2 a.1.2 (ε a.2.2) n) := (htimeM n).comp hargs
  have htM : Measurable (fun a : A => (a.2.1 : WithTop ℝ≥0)) :=
    WithTop.measurable_coe.comp measurable_snd.fst
  let D : ℕ → Set A := fun n => {a |
    eventTime a.1.1.1 a.1.1.2 a.1.2 (ε a.2.2) n ≤ (a.2.1 : WithTop ℝ≥0) ∧
    (a.2.1 : WithTop ℝ≥0) < eventTime a.1.1.1 a.1.1.2 a.1.2 (ε a.2.2) (n + 1)}
  have hDM (n : ℕ) : MeasurableSet (D n) :=
    (measurableSet_le (hTM n) htM).inter (measurableSet_lt htM (hTM (n + 1)))
  have hdisj (n m : ℕ) (a : A) (hn : a ∈ D n) (hm : a ∈ D m) : n = m := by
    have hmon : Monotone (eventTime a.1.1.1 a.1.1.2 a.1.2 (ε a.2.2)) :=
      (hmono a.1.1.1 a.1.1.2 a.1.2 (ε a.2.2)).2
    rcases lt_trichotomy n m with hlt | heq | hgt
    · exact False.elim ((not_lt_of_ge hm.1) (hn.2.trans_le (hmon (Nat.succ_le_of_lt hlt))))
    · exact heq
    · exact False.elim ((not_lt_of_ge hn.1) (hm.2.trans_le (hmon (Nat.succ_le_of_lt hgt))))
  -- This total auxiliary projection is used only on D_n, where the record is live.
  -- Its zero branch never supplies a source phase for a stopped record.
  let L : ℕ → A → ℝ≥0 × (E × E) := fun n a =>
    (record a.1.1.1 a.1.1.2 a.1.2 (ε a.2.2) n).elim id (fun _ => (0, (0, 0)))
  have hLM (n : ℕ) : Measurable (L n) :=
    (measurable_id.sumElim measurable_const).comp (hrM n)
  let branch : ℕ → A → E × E := fun n a =>
    Φ a.1.1.1 a.1.1.2 ((a.2.1 - (L n a).1 : ℝ≥0) : ℝ) (L n a).2

    hΦM.comp (measurable_fst.fst.prodMk
      ((measurable_coe_nnreal_real.comp (measurable_snd.fst.sub (hLM n).fst)).prodMk
        (hLM n).snd))
  let sets : Option ℕ → Set A
    | none => (⋃ n, D n)ᶜ
    | some n => D n
  let values : Option ℕ → A → E × E
    | none => fun a => a.1.2
    | some n => branch n
  have hsM (i : Option ℕ) : MeasurableSet (sets i) := by
    cases i with
    | none => exact (MeasurableSet.iUnion hDM).compl
    | some n => exact hDM n
  have hvM (i : Option ℕ) : Measurable (values i) := by
    cases i with
    | none => exact measurable_fst.snd
    | some n => exact hbM n
  have hcompat : Pairwise (fun i j => Set.EqOn (values i) (values j) (sets i ∩ sets j)) := by
    intro i j hij a ha
    cases i with
    | none =>
      cases j with
      | none => exact False.elim (hij rfl)
      | some m => exact False.elim (ha.1 (Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨m, ha.2⟩))
    | some n =>
      cases j with
      | none => exact False.elim (ha.2 (Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨n, ha.1⟩))
      | some m => exact False.elim (hij (congrArg some (hdisj n m a ha.1 ha.2)))
  obtain ⟨f, hfM, hf⟩ := exists_measurable_piecewise sets hsM values hvM hcompat
  let Z : E → E → (E × E) → ℝ≥0 → (ℕ → ℝ) → (E × E) :=
    fun y xRef z₀ t sample => f (((y, xRef), z₀), t, sample)
  have hZ (y xRef : E) (z₀ : E × E) (sample : ℕ → ℝ) (t : ℝ≥0)
      (n : ℕ) (a : ℝ≥0 × (E × E))
      (hl : eventTime y xRef z₀ (ε sample) n ≤ (t : WithTop ℝ≥0))
      (hu : (t : WithTop ℝ≥0) < eventTime y xRef z₀ (ε sample) (n + 1))
      (hr : record y xRef z₀ (ε sample) n = Sum.inl a) :
      Z y xRef z₀ t sample = Φ y xRef ((t - a.1 : ℝ≥0) : ℝ) a.2 := by
    have heq := hf (some n) (show (((y, xRef), z₀), t, sample) ∈ sets (some n) from ⟨hl, hu⟩)
    change f (((y, xRef), z₀), t, sample) = _
    rw [heq]
    dsimp [values, branch, L]
    rw [hr]
    rfl

  · intro y xRef z₀ sample t hn
    exact hf none (show (((y, xRef), z₀), t, sample) ∈ sets none from by
      intro hx
      obtain ⟨n, hnD⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hx
      exact hn ⟨n, hnD⟩)

    have hc := ActualPhysicalTimeCover.actual_fixed_reference_physical_time_cover
      hα hαβ hV hH hη hβη y xRef z₀
    have hp := AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.Probability.UnitExponentialProduct.unit_exponential_product_laws.2.2.2.1
    filter_upwards [hc, hp] with sample hcover hpositive

        hZ y xRef z₀ sample t n a hn.1 hn.2 ha.1⟩

        hinit y xRef z₀ (ε sample)

        | inr u =>
          change (0 : WithTop ℝ≥0) <
            (record y xRef z₀ (ε sample) 1).elim (fun a => (a.1 : WithTop ℝ≥0)) (fun _ => ⊤)
          rw [hr1]
          exact WithTop.coe_lt_top (0 : ℝ≥0)

          have hbpos : 0 < b.1 :=
            (hstrict y xRef z₀ (ε sample) 0 (0, z₀) hi0).2 b hepos hr1

          rw [hr1]
          exact WithTop.coe_lt_coe.mpr hbpos

The deterministic covered-arc characterization and uncovered fallback hold for every sample. Actual all-time agreement and initialization hold on one AE sample event for each fixed parameter triple. No uniform AE event over uncountably many parameter triples and no arbitrary correlated random-parameter law are inferred.

A stopped record has no phase and infinite event time; every covering interval has a live finite record. The last infinite-wait live arc remains covered. lesson.statement: Let E be any finite-dimensional real inner-product space, including dimension zero, with its Borel measurable structure. Let V:E→ℝ be C². Let α,β be nonnegative reals and η a real number satisfying α>0, α≤β, α‖v‖²≤D²V(x)[v,v]≤β‖v‖² for every x,v∈E, η>0, and βη≤1. Allow arbitrary parameters y,xRef∈E and initial phase z0=(x0,p0)∈E×E. Set c=y−η∇V(xRef). For z=(x,p), define the actual harmonic flow Φ_t(z)=(c+cos(t)(x−c)+√η sin(t)p, −sin(t)(x−c)/√η+cos(t)p), reflection S(z)=(x,p−[2〈p,g(x)〉/‖g(x)‖²]g(x)), residual g(x)=∇V(x)−∇V(xRef), and rate λ(z)=√η max{0,〈p,g(x)〉}. The reflection uses total real division, hence is the identity when g(x)=0. Define Λ(z,t)=∫_0^t λ(Φ_s(z)) ds for finite t≥0 and τ(z,e)=inf{t≥0:Λ(z,t)≥e}, with inf empty=∞. Let P be the actual countable product of rate-one exponential Borel measures on Ω=ℝ^ℕ; let ε_k(sample)=max{sample_k,0} viewed as a nonnegative real. Define active records (T,z) and an absorbing stopped record carrying no phase. Initialize record0=(0,z0). At index k, a stopped record stays stopped; an active record (T,z) becomes stopped if τ(z,ε_k)=∞ and otherwise becomes (T+τ(z,ε_k), S(Φ_{τ(z,ε_k)}(z))). Its event time T_k is the finite time component if active and ∞ if stopped. There exists a total phase map Z:E×E×(E×E)×[0,∞)×Ω→E×E jointly Borel measurable in all displayed parameters, finite physical time t and sample, while V,α,β,η remain fixed. For every parameter triple, every sample, every finite t and any actual covering index n with T_n≤t<T_(n+1), if record_n=inl(a) with a=(s,z), then Z(y,xRef,z0,t,sample)=Φ_(t−s)(z), where subtraction is the NNReal nonnegative subtraction. If no such actual covering index exists, Z(y,xRef,z0,t,sample)=z0. This uncovered value is an explicitly chosen ASTIS total representative convention, not a source state supplied on exceptional inputs. Furthermore, for each fixed deterministic y,xRef,z0, for P-almost every sample simultaneously: for every finite nonnegative t there exist n and an actual finite live record a=(s,z) with T_n≤t<T_(n+1), record_n=inl(a), s≤t, t−s<τ(z,ε_n) and Z(y,xRef,z0,t,sample)=Φ_(t−s)(z); and Z(y,xRef,z0,0,sample)=z0. A stopped record never provides the source phase. An infinite next wait retains the last live harmonic arc for all later finite t and does not trigger the uncovered fallback. The AE event may depend on the fixed parameter triple; no uniform event over all parameters is asserted. Joint measurability permits later measurable parameter evaluation, but per-parameter AE agreement cannot be substituted at arbitrary parameters correlated with sample without a separate law/independence/conditional-kernel argument. This is an ASTIS source-implicit measurable realization of Appendix A.1's actual between-jump prescription, not the full process/Markov/invariance/main sampler/error/query-cost/composition theorem. No positive dimension, energy, cap, selector, nonexplosion, positive support, measurable flow or higher regularity certificate is a new premise.

steps.text: Use the canonical Exp1 sample, actual NNReal thresholds, harmonic flow, reflection, integrated hazard, hitting time and guarded stopped recurrence. No witness or measurable clock is supplied as an extra assumption.

classical
  let P : Measure (ℕ → ℝ) := Measure.infinitePi (fun _ : ℕ => expMeasure (1 : ℝ))
  let ε : (ℕ → ℝ) → ℕ → ℝ≥0 := fun sample k => Real.toNNReal (sample k)
  let c : E → E → E := fun y xRef => y - η • gradient V xRef
  let Φ : E → E → ℝ → (E × E) → (E × E) := fun y xRef t z =>
    (c y xRef + Real.cos t • (z.1 - c y xRef) +
        (Real.sqrt η * Real.sin t) • z.2,
     (-Real.sin t / Real.sqrt η) • (z.1 - c y xRef) + Real.cos t • z.2)
  let S : E → (E × E) → (E × E) := fun xRef z =>
    (z.1, z.2 - (2 * inner ℝ z.2 (gradient V z.1 - gradient V xRef) /
      ‖gradient V z.1 - gradient V xRef‖ ^ 2) • (gradient V z.1 - gradient V xRef))
  let rate : E → (E × E) → ℝ := fun xRef z =>
    Real.sqrt η * max 0 (inner ℝ z.2 (gradient V z.1 - gradient V xRef))
  let Λ : E → E → (E × E) → ℝ≥0 → ℝ := fun y xRef z t =>
    ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..(t : ℝ), rate xRef (Φ y xRef s z)
  let τ : E → E → (E × E) → ℝ≥0 → WithTop ℝ≥0 := fun y xRef z e =>
    MeasureTheory.hittingAfter
      (fun t : ℝ≥0 => fun a : (E × E) × (E × E) × ℝ≥0 =>
        Λ a.1.1 a.1.2 a.2.1 t - (a.2.2 : ℝ))
      (Set.Ici (0 : ℝ)) 0 ((y, xRef), z, e)
  let next : E → E → ℝ≥0 → ((ℝ≥0 × (E × E)) ⊕ Unit) →
      ((ℝ≥0 × (E × E)) ⊕ Unit) := fun y xRef e r =>
    match r with
    | Sum.inr _ => Sum.inr ()
    | Sum.inl a =>
      if τ y xRef a.2 e = ⊤ then Sum.inr () else
        Sum.inl (a.1 + (τ y xRef a.2 e).untopD 0,
          S xRef (Φ y xRef (((τ y xRef a.2 e).untopD 0 : ℝ≥0) : ℝ) a.2))
  let record : E → E → (E × E) → (ℕ → ℝ≥0) → ℕ →
      ((ℝ≥0 × (E × E)) ⊕ Unit) := fun y xRef z₀ e n =>
    Nat.rec (Sum.inl (0, z₀)) (fun k r => next y xRef (e k) r) n

    fun y xRef z₀ e n => (record y xRef z₀ e n).elim
